cohort: Pregnant women with cardiac disease diagnosed during antenatal visits, previously diagnosed, admitted to the labor room, referred with cardiac disease, or who developed cardiac complications during the peripartum period beyond 32 weeks of gestation at a tertiary care hospital in Hyderabad, Telangana, India from 2018-2022.
finding: Rheumatic heart disease was the most common cardiac disease in pregnancy, and maternal complications occurred during labor and puerperium, though there was no maternal mortality.
